name: sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [ExistsAddOfLE α]
  {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → α}, (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ^ 2 ≤ ↑s.card * ∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2
result.informal_name: Square of Sum Inequality for Finite Sets
result.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ and function $ f $ mapping elements of $ s $ to an additive commutative monoid, the square of the sum of $ f(i) $ over $ s $ is less than or equal to the product of the cardinality of $ s $ and the sum of the squares of $ f(i) $ over $ s $. Formally, $\left(\sum_{i \in s} f(i)\right)^2 \leq \#s \cdot \sum_{i \in s} f(i)^2$.

name: enorm_sum_le
result.signature: (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ε) : ‖∑ i ∈ s, f i‖ₑ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ₑ
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {ε : Type u_9} [inst : TopologicalSpace ε] [inst_1 : ESeminormedAddCommMonoid ε] (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → ε), ‖∑ i ∈ s, f i‖ₑ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ₑ
result.informal_name: Extended Norm Triangle Inequality for Finite Sums
result.informal_description: In a seminormed additive commutative monoid $\varepsilon$, for any finite set $s \subseteq \iota$ and function $f : \iota \to \varepsilon$, the extended norm of the sum $\left\| \sum_{i \in s} f(i) \right\|_e$ is less than or equal to the sum of the extended norms $\sum_{i \in s} \|f(i)\|_e$.

result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ENNReal) {p : ℝ},
  1 ≤ p → (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ^ p ≤ ↑s.card ^ (p - 1) * ∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ p
result.value:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hp with hp | hp
  · simp [← hp]
  let q : ℝ := p / (p - 1)
  have hpq : p.HolderConjugate q := .conjExponent hp
  have hp₁ : 1 / p * p = 1 := one_div_mul_cancel hpq.ne_zero
  have hq : 1 / q * p = p - 1 := by
    rw [← hpq.div_conj_eq_sub_one]
    ring
  simpa only [ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ hpq.nonneg, ← ENNReal.rpow_mul, hp₁, hq, coe_one, one_mul, one_rpow,
    rpow_one, Pi.one_apply, sum_const, Nat.smul_one_eq_cast] using
    ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow (inner_l...
result.informal_name: Upper bound for the p-th power of a sum
result.informal_description:
Let $s$ be a finite set, and let $f$ be a function that maps each element $i \in s$ to an extended non-negative real number $f(i) \in [0, \infty]$. For any real number $p \ge 1$, the following inequality holds:
$$ \left( \sum_{i \in s} f(i) \right)^p \le |s|^{p-1} \sum_{i \in s} (f(i))^p $$
where $|s|$ is the cardinality of the set $s$.

name: nnnorm_sum_le_of_le
result.signature:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → E} {n : ι → NNReal},
  (∀ b ∈ s, ‖f b‖₊ ≤ n b) → ‖∑ b ∈ s, f b‖₊ ≤ ∑ b ∈ s, n b
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → E} {n : ι → NNReal},
  (∀ b ∈ s, ‖f b‖₊ ≤ n b) → ‖∑ b ∈ s, f b‖₊ ≤ ∑ b ∈ s, n b
result.informal_name: Triangle Inequality for Finite Sums in Seminormed Additive Commutative Groups
result.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $, a function $ f : s \to E $ into a seminormed additive commutative group $ E $, and a function $ n : s \to \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0} $, if $ \|f(b)\|_+ \leq n(b) $ for all $ b \in s $, then $ \left\|\sum_{b \in s} f(b)\right\|_+ \leq \sum_{b \in s} n(b) $.

name: nnnorm_sum_le
result.signature:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → E),
  ‖∑ a ∈ s, f a‖₊ ≤ ∑ a ∈ s, ‖f a‖₊
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → E),
  ‖∑ a ∈ s, f a‖₊ ≤ ∑ a ∈ s, ‖f a‖₊
result.informal_name: Triangle Inequality for Finite Sums in Seminormed Additive Commutative Groups
result.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ of type $ \iota $ and any function $ f : \iota \to E $ in a seminormed additive commutative group $ E $, the non-negative norm of the sum $ \sum_{a \in s} f(a) $ is less than or equal to the sum of the non-negative norms of $ f(a) $, i.e., $ \left\| \sum_{a \in s} f(a) \right\|_+ \leq \sum_{a \in s} \| f(a) \|_+ $.
